components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel, back, or alternative action. White fill, pink border, ink text.

narrative.overview:
This is not a SaaS dashboard. It's a mission-control interface designed to make one person feel like they have ten people behind them. Every screen is built for one-handed use between client calls — dark charcoal hero panels that feel premium and purposeful, warm cream surfaces for working content, and a shocking pink heart at every interaction point.

The app runs in two modes: warm (default, daytime) and dark (premium night atmosphere). Both share the same charcoal mission panels (#1C1C1E/#2C2C2E) — the dark hero sections never adapt between themes. In warm mode, the brand pink is the deeper, punchier #E91E6A; in dark mode it softens to #FF70A6.

This design explicitly rejects: the vibe-coded AI-app look; toy-like cartoon superhero treatments; and cold corporate SaaS. Every screen should feel like it was built by someone who knows exactly what Sandra needs — and delivered it finished.
keyCharacteristics: Dark charcoal hero panels anchor every screen; warm cream surfaces float below
One brand color (pink) used with discipline: CTAs, focus rings, 3px hero border, active nav
Two typefaces with a clear job division: Fraunces owns names and numbers; Inter owns UI text
Dollar amounts always Fraunces with tabular-nums
AI-facing elements: ✦ prefix, #FF78B0 pink, uppercase — visually distinct from all other labels
44×44px minimum tap targets and pink focus rings enforced everywhere

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: Pink is a single-color system: #E91E6A in warm mode, #FF70A6 in dark mode. No competing accents. Pink means action, active, or AI. Everything else is neutral.

rules.name: The Hero Seal Rule
rules.body: Every dark hero section ends with border-bottom: 3px solid #E91E6A. This is the visual brand signature. Never skip it. Never render the pink logo banner directly touching a pink section.

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear on cards (ambient diffusion) and the FAB (emphasis). That's the entire shadow vocabulary. No shadow on inputs, banners, the logo bar, badges, or navigation.

rules.name: The Flat Hero Rule
rules.body: The dark hero panel's depth is conveyed by tonal contrast alone. No shadow on hero sections.

rules.name: The Fraunces / Inter Split
rules.body: Names, amounts, and hero display text: Fraunces only. Labels, buttons, body copy, meta: Inter only. Never mix within a single semantic unit.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: All UI labels, buttons, section headers, and form labels use sentence case. ALL CAPS reserved for: badge/tag text (UNPAID, VIP), and AI card label prefixes (✦ PREFERENCES).

dos: Do apply border-bottom: 3px solid #E91E6A to every dark hero section.
Do use Fraunces for all names, amounts, and hero display text; Inter for all labels, buttons, and body copy.
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to every dollar amount.
Do use .sm-input class (pink focus border) on every form field — focus rings are never suppressed.
Do enforce 44×44px minimum tap targets on every interactive element.
Do convert any <div onClick> to <button type="button"> with a descriptive aria-label.
Do use sentence case for all UI labels, section headers, and button text.
Do use America/Toronto timezone in all date and time formatting.
Do soft-delete only: deleted_at = now(). Never hard-delete jobs, clients, or workers.
Do replace window.confirm() with the in-app two-tap confirm pattern.
Do trigger hapticFeedback() on significant actions: book, complete, pay, submit.
Do include the radial pink glow ::before on every dark hero section and AI card.
Do use the dual-theme system via T = smTokens(mode) — never hardcode theme-variable colors.
donts: Don't ship a vibe-coded look: inconsistent spacing, mismatched type scales, generic component defaults.
Don't use toy-like cartoon superhero treatments — cape badges, exclamation-heavy copy, comic-book iconography.
Don't build cold corporate SaaS: gray metric-hero tiles, B2B blue palette, enterprise chrome.
Don't suppress focus rings. outline: none only acceptable when paired with .sm-input pink border on focus.
Don't use gradients on view toggle buttons. Active toggle = solid T.pink only.
Don't render the pink logo banner directly touching a pink or pink-tinted section.
Don't add a 5th bottom navigation item. The AI assistant is a FAB, not a tab.
Don't use window.confirm(). Two-tap in-app confirm only.
Don't use purple gradients, purple-tinted blacks, glassmorphism, or neon accents.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent — use full borders, tints, or leading icons.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Pink is on surfaces, not text.
Don't add a CSS transition to the keyboard spacer div. Instant height change only.
Don't use system timezone anywhere. America/Toronto everywhere.
